lessons.description: Seven to ten questions on email marketing, with an answer key.
lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining
> questions are not written yet.

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Email Marketing, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. Why is an email list described as a channel you own?
+ You hold the addresses and can reach them without a platform deciding who sees it
- Email is free to send at any volume
- Email never lands in a spam folder
= Social reach is granted by an algorithm; a list is yours. That is also why deliverability matters so much.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

## What to submit

:::template Submission cover sheet
Name:
Brand:

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
- Quality and realism of the deliverable — 30 marks
- Clarity of presentation and reasoning — 20 marks

A pass is 50. Anything that invents data about a real company scores zero on realism.
